sources.title: Dphn Dolphin Mistral 24B Venice Edition - localai.computer
sources.snippet: Quick answer: Dphn Dolphin Mistral 24B Venice Edition needs roughly 13 GB VRAM for Q4_K_M and 19 GB for Q5_K_M. Use Q8 (25 GB) or FP16 (49 GB) for higher quality output. Full-model (FP16) requirements are shown by default. Quantized builds like Q4 trade accuracy for lower VRAM usage. Ready to buy?
